name: Map
author: BedrockRelay
description: A map of the 128 × 128 blocks around a player, drawn like an in-game map, with their head in the middle and anyone nearby where they stand. Drawing one takes a few seconds and a little of the server's time each tick, so maps are one at a time with a short pause between them.
privacy: A map shows the land around a player, which can give away where their base is, so keep this to people you trust.

screenshots.caption: /map: the land around a player, drawn like an in-game map, with their head in the middle
